_comment: Single source of truth for the public-route sweeps. Consumed by the e2e specs
(via public-routes.ts) and by scripts/*.mjs (via fs.readFileSync) so there is
exactly one list to keep correct.
This file exists because there were FIVE hardcoded copies of this list, and they
had drifted: /achievements and /privacy-center were on every one of them while
both call requireUser() and 307 to /login. Playwright follows redirects, so the
sweeps were auditing the login page under two other names and passing.
Before adding a route to `public`, load it signed-out and confirm it renders
itself. If it redirects, it belongs in `authGated` instead — the sweeps assert
the landed path matches the requested one and will fail loudly either way.

authGated._comment: Verified to redirect signed-out, or to require a session/token. Auditing these needs a signed-in sweep; including them in `public` measures the login page instead.
